baseline.condition: Declared routes, forward driving, standard instantaneous lane changes, and no collision, teleport or vehicle relocation. Near-end complete E1 passages require an exit from the detector lane to the route's next road. Different observed roads alone do not imply repeated or multiple detector contributions.

through.condition: Declared routes, forward driving, standard instantaneous lane changes, and no collision, teleport or vehicle relocation. Near-end complete E1 passages require an exit from the detector lane to the route's next road. Different observed roads alone do not imply repeated or multiple detector contributions.

claim_boundary: Conditional complete-passage upper bound, not natural driver behavior or safety proof. The larger run violates the no-collision/no-teleport premise.
